description: Template-based list rendering with safe data binding: property paths only, sanitized HTML, and URL-checked attribute bindings

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to fetch JSON items from (an array, or an object with items/data). Fetched once on upgrade and on change; a newer src aborts the older request.

attributes.name: data-items
attributes.description: Inline JSON array of items. Takes priority over src.

attributes.name: data-key
attributes.description: Item property used as the unique key for the keyed diff. Missing or duplicated keys fall back to the item index.

attributes.name: data-loading
attributes.description: Present while a src fetch is in flight (with aria-busy="true").

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Error message of the last failed src fetch; cleared when a new fetch starts. Also announced via the role="status" child.

events.name: card-list:rendered
events.description: Fired after items are rendered or reconciled.

events.name: card-list:items-changed
events.description: Fired when the items change. source is 'attribute' for data-items, src and data-key, 'api' for the .items setter.

events.name: card-list:upgraded
events.description: Fired once the component has found its template and upgraded.

childAttributes.name: data-field
childAttributes.description: Set the element's text content from a property path (e.g. user.name).

childAttributes.name: data-field-attr
childAttributes.description: Comma-separated 'attribute: path' pairs. on* attributes, style and srcdoc are refused; URL attributes (href, src, action, formaction, poster, srcset, ...) only accept http(s), mailto, tel, relative or fragment URLs. null/undefined removes the attribute.

childAttributes.name: data-field-html
childAttributes.description: Set innerHTML from a property path, passed through the shared sanitizer.

childAttributes.name: data-field-if
childAttributes.description: Element is [hidden] unless the property value is truthy.

childAttributes.name: data-field-unless
childAttributes.description: Element is [hidden] when the property value is truthy.

childAttributes.name: data-fallback
childAttributes.description: Static no-JS content; removed on the first successful render.

structure.description: Card template cloned per item. A single root element enables the keyed diff.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Get the current items, or assign an array to re-render via the keyed diff (cancels an in-flight src fetch). setItems()/getItems() were removed.
